description: Source code for the SoftVorbis audio decoder component in Android's stagefright media framework, implementing Vorbis decoding with port management, parameter handling, and decoding logic.

classes.name: SoftVorbis
classes.description: Android media component for decoding Vorbis audio streams, managing ports, decoding state, and handling input/output buffers.

methods.name: initPorts
methods.description: Initializes input and output ports with appropriate configurations.

methods.name: initDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the decoder; currently a stub returning OK.

methods.name: internalGetParameter
methods.description: Handles retrieval of component parameters such as port formats and Vorbis-specific info.

methods.name: internalSetParameter
methods.description: Handles setting of component parameters, including component role and port formats.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is configured with valid state and info.

methods.name: makeBitReader
methods.description: Prepares bit reading structures for decoding Vorbis headers.

methods.name: handleEOS
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream signaling, updating buffer flags and signaling downstream.

methods.name: onQueueFilled
methods.description: Main decoding loop, processing input buffers, initializing headers, decoding audio frames, and outputting PCM data.

methods.name: onPortFlushCompleted
methods.description: Resets decoder state upon port flush.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets internal state and frees resources.
